profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I'm a senior software developer with broad experience in web, application, and systems programming.  I've held positions that required project technical leadership, mentoring, technical writing, design proposals, and the actual implementation of them.  I have a special interest in operating systems development and design specifically focused on software life-cycle management and deployment.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and development of significant portions of the packaging system found in Solaris 11 and later.

Refactoring and sustaining of open source software build and packaging system.

Design and development of future analytics/observability functionality in Solaris.

Debugging and analysis of system integration architecture and implementation.

Architecture review committee member.

Porting and refactoring of storage appliance framework to new systems architecture.

Responsible for and assisted in development, integration, and coordination of platform development tools such as  Python, rust, Go, LLVM, etc.

Prototype of port and packaging of GNOME for Solaris.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and development of significant portions of the packaging system found in Solaris 11 and later.

Debugging, analysis, and implementation of low-level and high-level operating system functionality.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Design and development of significant portions of core development tools that included an application framework, software packaging and deployment, software change management, and data archival retention.

Design and development of Payment Application, Customer Relationship Management, and Systems Management portions of a transaction processing system.

Development liaison between application developers and core development team.

Authored significant portions of documentation and training material for core development tools.

positions.title: Software and Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Development and design of web-based applications used for asset, inventory, work order, and scheduling management using the Oracle Database.

Software design and development for significant portions of two versions of flagship product, as well as an internal application usage and tracking tool used for management of applications and billing.

Design and development of system navigation interfaces, record management functionality, and e-mail distribution systems.

Design and development of Customer Relationship, Order, Asset, and Sales management portions of software.

Creation, selection and design of interface graphics for company applications using Photoshop and The GNU Image Manipulation Program.

Key person for systems management, software deployment, software package creation, and software updates for a GNU/Linux-based platform environment.

positions.title: Technical Support Professional
positions.description:
Member of Gateway’s special Fortune 500 and Government accounts technical support staff.

Handled an average of 35-40 calls a day, with an average call time of 11 minutes, and a first time resolution of 98%.

projects.title: Image Packaging System
projects.description: pkg(7), the image packaging system, is an attempt to design and implement a software delivery system with interaction with a network repository as its primary design goal. Other key ideas are: safe execution for zones and other installation contexts, use of ZFS for efficiency and rollback, preventing the introduction of incorrect or incomplete packages, and efficient use of bandwidth.

projects.title: IQ Coordinator
projects.description:
IQ Coordinator is a single, large SaaS application that runs most of the aspects of an Professional Service Company, including:
 - Opportunity Tracking, Sales Forecasting, and Reporting
 - Order, Inventory, Asset, and Project Management
 - Crew Scheduling, Time Collection, Job Costing
 - Custom Pricing, ecommerce, and Invoicing
